worker_closure_check.meaning: None of the24 listed development worker PIDs existed at inspection.

background_observation.method: ps -A -o pid=,ppid=,pcpu=,comm= filtered to reported CPU above20%
background_observation.scope: Point-in-time process-reported CPU, not a controlled instantaneous machine utilization measurement. Unrelated command arguments and project paths are intentionally omitted.

control_boundary: No unrelated process is stopped or reprioritized. FFWB-owned tests, training, profiling, package/control games and other match runs will be stopped before the primary final. Four registered match workers remain the sole FFWB experimental workload.
limitation: Whole-machine isolation is not established. Shared host load may affect time-limited decisions and pair independence. Inferential intervals remain conditional on their stated independence assumption; no arena, algorithm-only or controlled-hardware claim.
